verdict.rationale: Style-guide linting is a fair question for a docs platform, but the evidence never documents automated checks against a style guide. The closest items are GitBook Agent reviewing change requests (title only) and flagging outdated content. Those are adjacent accuracy and review features, not style-guide linting that blocks or flags issues before publish.

support.subject: As a technical writer, automated checks lint my content against a style guide and flag issues before they publish
